stops.name: St. Wolfgang
stops.quote: Since 1964, St. Wolfgang has officially held the title of a climatic health resort.
stops.english: Since 1964, St. Wolfgang has officially held the title of a climatic health resort.

stops.name: Schafberg Railway
stops.quote: Highlights include rides on the Schafberg Railway, boat trips between the lakeside villages, and swimming areas along the shore.
stops.english: Highlights include rides on the Schafberg Railway, boat trips between the lakeside villages, and swimming areas along the shore.

stops.name: Schafberg
stops.quote: Geographically, Lake Wolfgangsee is situated in an idyllic alpine landscape, nestled between the Schafberg to the west and the Zwölferhorn to the east – two prominent mountains popular with families for outings.
stops.english: Geographically, Lake Wolfgangsee is situated in an idyllic alpine landscape, nestled between the Schafberg to the west and the Zwölferhorn to the east – two prominent mountains popular with families for outings.

stops.name: St. Gilgen
stops.quote: In the birthplace of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s mother and the home of his sister ‘Nannerl’, sophisticated chic meets lakeside living.
stops.english: In the birthplace of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s mother and the home of his sister ‘Nannerl’, sophisticated chic meets lakeside living.

stops.name: Ochsenkreuz
stops.quote: On a small island near Falkenstein in St. Gilgen stands the Ochsenkreuz, a historic wayside shrine linked to the legend of a butcher and his ox.
stops.english: On a small island near Falkenstein in St. Gilgen stands the Ochsenkreuz, a historic wayside shrine linked to the legend of a butcher and his ox.

stops.name: Strobl
stops.quote: Sunbathing lawn in Strobl with trees, bathing jetty, playground, buffet and boat hire.
stops.english: Sunbathing lawn in Strobl with trees, bathing jetty, playground, buffet and boat hire.

stops.name: Postalm
stops.quote: Around 12 kilometres above Strobl lies the Postalm, Austria's largest connected alpine pasture area.
stops.english: Around 12 kilometres above Strobl lies the Postalm, Austria's largest connected alpine pasture area.
